description: LANDFIRE is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by USFS | Rocky Mountain Research Station | Fire, Fuel, and Smoke Science Program; USGS Earth Resources Observation and Science Center; The Nature Conservancy. Access map layers, databases, and ecological models related to fire for the United States and some island territories. The site also features an array of useful Help features to assist new users in accomplishing common tasks. This site represents a shared program between the wildland fire management programs of the U.S. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Wildfire. Assets: Forestry, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
